item.text:
**Verdict:** Mixed, leaning negative. There is real evidence of inclusive, technocratic programs for women, youth, and disaster-hit areas, but the dominant 2024 pattern is unequal treatment of Kurdish constituencies, women/LGBT people, and refugees, plus coercive control over local mandates and housing in disaster zones.

| Side | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|

This is strong, if indirect, evidence for equal opportunity rather than pure aggregate welfare. | 6B.8; 6B.4; 6B.5 |

Search gap: I did not find strong direct 2024 evidence on disability rights or formal anti-discrimination enforcement in public services. The record is strongest on women/LGBT, Kurdish constituencies, refugees, and disaster housing.
